pipeline_warnings: Source size not trusted: at its file units the source is 156.41 cm tall; it was rescaled to a chosen height of 30.0 cm (effective source_units_to_m=0.1918). glTF units are metres, but the GLB measures 1.56 m tall x 1.54 m wide x 1.69 m deep (Blender Z-up), a nonsensical size for a house cat (generated meshes come out normalised to ~1.5-2 units). Rescaled to a chosen 30 cm sitting height (plausible domestic cat, head + ears). This is a guess, not a measurement: needs human confirmation of the intended in-game size.

Source topology is not clean (after welding coincident verts): 49 non-manifold edges, 231 open boundary edges, 66 non-manifold verts, 7 separate parts (vert counts [1359, 20, 11, 10, 6, 4, 3]). Unwelded as imported: 2380 boundary edges, 277 parts.
Source is already low-poly (2,680 tris), at or below the LOD0 budget (3,000); LOD budgets were set relative to the source, not to a 'high-poly to game-res' reduction.
Static mesh only: the source has no rig/armature and the pipeline does not do skinning (step 'skinning' = not_implemented).
ORM roughness (G=0.6) and metallic (B=0.0) are constants, not measured; only R (AO) is baked.

Base colour is a bake transfer of the source texture (texture_20250901) onto LOD0's new UVs: it carries the source texture's blotches/baked-in lighting, and texels whose rays missed the source stay black (27.16% of the texture is black, including empty UV space).
LOD0 has 3 UV-flipped faces (Smart UV Project).
Retopo proxy needed repair: 348 faces on non-manifold edges removed and holes filled before QuadriFlow (bake still uses the untouched sculpt).

[manual review of previews] Whiskers are gone on LOD0-3: they were thin open/non-manifold strips, removed by the proxy repair (348 faces on non-manifold edges deleted) and QuadriFlow; the baked BC/normal maps leave dark dash marks on the cheeks where they were.

[manual review of previews] Baked base colour has black holes on the back of the tail/rump and under the feet, where the remeshed LOD0 surface moved away from the source further than the bake ray distance (5% of height) or rays hit nothing.
[manual review of previews] Baked normal map shows dark streak artifacts at the cheeks (whisker roots), under the collar/bell and on the hind legs/tail base.

[manual review of previews] LOD0 is ~3 cm shorter than the source bbox (29.4 vs 32.4 cm): stray thin shard geometry below the feet in the source (visible as thin lines in the source render) was dropped; ear tips are slightly rounded but ears, tail and paws survive at all LODs.

[manual review of previews] The collar bell is smeared into the collar on LOD0 (small separate part, lost detail); the source texture itself is blotchy (painted tabby patches, baked-in shading) and that is carried into T_Mochi_BC.png.
[manual review of previews] Validator (Mochi profile): 6 reversed-winding triangles and 5 repeated-vertex degenerate triangles in the combined FBX - not fixed in this test run.

[manual review of previews] Target height 30 cm was applied to the wrong axis (glTF importer leaves a quaternion rotation on the object, so local Z was the depth axis): the asset came out 32.4 cm tall (source bbox) / 29.4 cm (LOD0), still plausible for a cat. Fixed in 01_import.py for future runs (uses world-space Z), not re-run.
Unreal import not tested: the LodGroup in the combined FBX is written via a runtime patch to Blender's exporter and has only been verified by re-importing into Blender.
